title: Conservative derivative contract for VZAA-derived research
premise: The published VZAA formulation fails SWAP5 hard gates for exact accepted-step conservation and explicit prescribed bottom head/flux boundaries. Any further work must therefore be a separately named conservative derivative, not a silent repair claimed as reproduced VZAA.
candidate_step_structure: Start exclusively from committed state at t0 and immutable forcing/boundary data for [t0,t1].
Compute a source-bound VZAA-style layer-local analytical predictor without committing any state.
Construct the exact accepted-step external mass target from top boundary, imposed bottom flux if applicable, distributed sinks/sources and other explicit exchanges.
Apply at most a preconfigured bounded number of conservative correction sweeps. Every internal correction transfer is entered once with opposite signs in adjacent layer balances.
For prescribed bottom flux, bottom exchange is fixed by the boundary and may not be altered to hide a profile residual.

For prescribed bottom head, bottom flux is an interface unknown. The correction must produce a conservative profile and an explicit head residual H_candidate_bottom-H_boundary; no water may be created to force the head residual to zero.
Accept only when storage, all external transfers and all sinks/sources close the mass ledger to roundoff-scale numerical tolerance and all state admissibility constraints hold.
Reject trial explicitly when bounded correction cannot satisfy the declared boundary/residual criteria. Rejection leaves committed state bitwise unchanged.

mass_invariants.accepted_step_ledger: DeltaS = Q_top - Q_bottom - sinks + sources + other_explicit_external_transfers
mass_invariants.internal_transfer_sum: exactly zero by paired debit-credit construction before floating-point summation error

prescribed_flux.acceptance: realized q_bottom equals imposed boundary value under the shared sign convention; profile correction cannot alter the external amount

prescribed_head.acceptance: mass closure is mandatory; a nonzero head residual is admissible only inside a separately qualified coupling tolerance

correction_constraints.direction: bottom-up is the primary research candidate because the published predictor is top-down and the unresolved hard boundary is at the bottom

response_tangent_research.preferred_quantity: dq_bottom/dH_bottom or inverse dH_bottom/dq_bottom when locally well conditioned
response_tangent_research.preferred_method: propagate local analytical/implicit sensitivities through predictor and bounded correction sweep
response_tangent_research.reference_method: symmetric perturbation on identical committed state
response_tangent_research.invalid_at_regime_switch: mark tangent unavailable rather than return an unqualified derivative

qualification_sequence: equation-level conservative ledger proof on a synthetic two/three-layer harness
prescribed-bottom-flux test including upward and downward exchange
heterogeneous interface test using SWAP hydraulic functions
timestep and layer-count sensitivity against FullRichards
hard_failures: accepted-step mass residual not reducible to floating-point accumulation without compensating hidden flux
prescribed bottom flux cannot be honored exactly in the ledger
prescribed head can be met only by altering stored water without a declared flux
upward groundwater exchange requires clipping or sign suppression
